name: Sofitel Algiers Hamma Garden
desc: Discover luxury and comfort at Sofitel Algiers Hamma Garden. Close to the Botanical Garden Hamma, our hotel has 309 rooms and 23 spacious air-conditioned suites with free WiFi. Guests can unwind in our 3 restaurants that serve French, gourmet and regional dishes, our bar, terrace and pool, solarium and fitness center. We also have 6 meeting rooms for hosting business events.

name: Hôtel Mercure Alger Aéroport
desc: Mercure Alger Aeroport is your gateway to the Algerian capital in a comfortable setting of over 307 spacious rooms. Our hotel is in the heart of the business district and only 5 min from the airport, making it ideal for business or family trips. Mercure Alger Aeroport has an outdoor pool and large garden for your enjoyment! Mercure hotels are committed to quality and providing staff dedicated to you.
address: B.P. 12, 5 Juillet, Route de l'université, Bab Ezzouar

name: Mercure Alger Palais Des Congres
desc: Mercure Alger Palais des Congres features 152 rooms including 8 suits with breathtaking views of the Mediterranean sea reflecting the city distinctive charm. For business and event needs, the hotel provides a modern event space with 6 meeting rooms , a conference hall and a ceremony ball room. Two different themed restaurants where guests can indulge in culinary delights: a cosmopolitan restaurant buffet and a…

name: Novotel Constantine
desc: Novotel Constantine offers an enjoyable stay in our complex of 117 comfortable, well-equipped rooms with views of the mountain or the city. To make your stay even more enjoyable, we have a fitness room, sauna and free car park. Relax in our bar and restaurant and enjoy our chef's specialties. With free WIFI and 4 meeting rooms, our hotel is ideal for business guests.

name: ibis Constantine
desc: A stone's throw from Martyrs Square, the ibis Constantine Hotel offers 172 budget warmly-decorated bedrooms, with private bathroom facilities, an office area and air conditioning. Offering unlimited access to WiFi, our property offers a free private car park and on-demand childcare. It also has a bar and restaurant serving an all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet and Mediterranean-flavoured cuisine.

name: Hotel Oran Bay Managed By Accor
desc: On the coast of the emerging city of Oran with a breathtaking view of the Mediterranean Sea, enjoy moments together at the Atrium, our English bar LE PUB or swimming pool at our 321-room hotel. Ideal for business or leisure travel, Hôtel Oran Bay has 6 meeting rooms, including 1 modular ballroom, for hosting professional or private events. Le Canastel restaurant is the perfect place for friendly meet-ups.
address: Hai Ibn Rochd, Nommé Route Des Falaises, B.P 7221

name: Royal Hotel Oran - MGallery Collection
desc: You'll discover luxury and elegance at the Royal Hotel Oran Mgallery by Sofitel. The historic super luxury hotel is graced with antique furniture and works of art, and has 112 spacious and air-conditioned rooms with unlimited WIFI. Feel free to relax with its wellness center, fitness room, 2 restaurants and bar. Plus 3 meeting rooms, private parking and free airport shuttle.
address: 3 Boulevard de la Soummam, BP 284, BP 284

name: ibis Oran les Falaises
desc: ibis Oran Les Falaises welcomes you to a modern, bright and economical 150-bedroom complex with unlimited WiFi, air conditioning, private bathroom, office area and flat-screen TV. We also offer free parking, a bar where you can relax after sightseeing and a Mediterranean restaurant with an all-you-can-eat buffet breakfast. At the edge of the Oran Bay, it promises a pleasant stay at a low price.
address: Avenue De Canastel, Route Des Falaises

name: Sofitel Thalassa Algiers Club des Pins (Decembre 2026)
desc: Facing the Mediterranean, Sofitel Thalassa Club des Pins Algiers reveals a haven where luxury meets well-being. Its 182 rooms and suites, all facing the sea, invite you to slow down. At the heart of the hotel, the thalassotherapy institute, with 77 treatment rooms, offers a sensory journey through treatments, pools and serenity. Three restaurants, a lounge, panoramic terraces and a flexible room for up to 400 guests…

name: ibis Tlemcen
desc: Located 10 minutes from the downtown area, ibis Tlemcen offers 120 budget bedrooms with bathroom facilities, office area, flat screen TV, air conditioning and free WiFi. It welcomes both tourists and business guests. It has 2 rooms to organise your meetings. There is also a bar with terrace and a Mediterranean restaurant serving an all-you-can-eat buffet for breakfast.
address: Boulevard El Kiffane, Wilaya de Tlemcen, 13000
